format.description: Must match metadata.format; this verifies the selected file format without conversion.

monochrome.description: true recolors SVG; false leaves PNG unchanged.

labels.description: Optional SVG label text. An empty object adds no text and is accepted for PNG.

include_example_labels.description: true adds example text to SVG; false leaves PNG unchanged.

data.description: Read the selected asset metadata.data_input for required fields, counts and numeric constraints.
